doclist.frameSearch: Search framework contracts by name or number (optional)
doclist.settledNowHint: Confirm the default delivery and payment milestones on save (stock follows the delivery rules).
doclist.settleStopped: The transaction was saved, but confirming it right away stopped.

settle.STOCK_INSUFFICIENT: Not enough stock to ship. Adjust stock or quantity, then confirm delivery in the transaction.
settle.DELIVERY_OVER: Delivered quantity exceeds the ordered quantity. Open the transaction to confirm again.
settle.DELIVERY_INVALID: Delivery details are not valid. Open the transaction to confirm again.
settle.DELIVERY_LOCKED: The delivery milestone is locked. Open the transaction to handle it.
settle.other: Could not confirm (code {{code}}). Open the transaction to confirm the remaining milestones.

doclist.attachFailed: Could not attach to the framework contract (same partner and same buy/sell direction required).
